name: A Way In
summary: A Syndicate trade draws you toward Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands. You need a disguise from Northfold Manor to enter without suspicion.

sections.title: A Hidden Trade
sections.body: A contact sends you to Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands, where the Syndicate holds important dealings behind its walls. Word has reached them of a trade between Syndicate members, and its details may be inside the keep. To enter without arousing suspicion, you need a Syndicate uniform from Northfold Manor.

faq.q: What is happening at Stromgarde Keep?
faq.answer: The Syndicate uses Stromgarde Keep as one of its largest strongholds, and a trade between its members is taking place somewhere in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Why am I going to Northfold Manor?
faq.answer: You are looking for a Syndicate uniform at Northfold Manor to disguise yourself before entering Stromgarde Keep.

faq.q: What do I need to enter the keep?
faq.answer: You need a Syndicate uniform from Northfold Manor to enter Stromgarde Keep without arousing suspicion.

faq.q: What is the Syndicate trade about?
faq.answer: The trade is between Syndicate members somewhere in the Arathi Highlands. Its details may be found inside Stromgarde Keep.
